name: Tandoori Tofu
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 120 ml tomato sauce or tomato paste
2 tablespoons olive oil or canola oil
Preferred seasonings (suggested seasonings: turmeric, pepper, hot sauce, salt)

steps: Spread out the tofu on a cookie sheet and bake for 20–25 minutes at 170 -. This releases the extra water from the tofu and dries it out to be able to absorb the marinade.
Mix the spices, tomato sauce, yogurt, and oil in a bowl.
Let the tofu marinate well (about 8 hours) in this mixture, preferably in the refrigerator.
After marinating, thread the tofu onto skewers and grill it.
